definitions: A mark, object, or figure formed by two short intersecting lines or pieces.
An upright post with a transverse bar, used in antiquity for crucifixion.
A mixture or compromise between two different things.
An animal or plant produced by cross-breeding.
A pass of a ball from one side of the pitch to the centre in football.
examples: A cross between a dog and a wolf.
He headed the cross into the goal.
The burden was a heavy cross to bear.
